minutes.headline: Town Meeting heard the FY18 budget; a motion to cut the school line was on the floor when the captions end
minutes.summary: Town Meeting opened with the pledge and thanks to retiring members, then worked through the warrant: revolving funds, a prior-year transfers article and the capital plan. An amendment on the capital plan moved money from a police ATV to the Wallace playground. The omnibus budget was presented and discussed by category, with debate on retiree health liabilities and school spending. A motion to reduce the school line was pending at the end.

what_happened.line: A motion to reduce the school line item was pending when the captions end; no resolution is recorded.
The moderator explained that the school budget can only be amended by changing its bottom-line number, so a smaller, special-education-based cut could not be a separate line.
The FY18 omnibus budget motion was read and then presented and discussed by category, including insurance, retiree health and the school budget.
An amendment to move money from the Wallace playground project to a police ATV in the capital plan was put to a vote; the result is not audible.
Town Meeting took up the stormwater task force revolving fund and a list of prior-year line-item transfers before the capital plan.

why_it_matters: The school line is the largest part of the town budget, mostly paid by property taxes, so a cut to its bottom line changes what the schools can spend and what Town Meeting is asked to raise.
The capital plan amendment shows how a small change from the floor can move money between a playground and a public safety vehicle, and the minutes do not record how it was decided.
